proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha hb hc
  have key : a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 - 3 * a * b * c = (a + b + c) * ((a - b) ^ 2 + (b - c) ^ 2 + (c - a) ^ 2) / 2 := by
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : (a + b + c) * ((a - b) ^ 2 + (b - c) ^ 2 + (c - a) ^ 2) = 0 := by
      linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h0 with h1 | h1
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · have h2 : (a - b) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        linarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
      have h3 : (b - c) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        linarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
      have h4 : a - b = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 h2
      have h5 : b - c = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 h3
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    ring
